verdicts.reason: Both shrink the crowd illustration into a thin, hard-cropped strip at the top where the figures are tiny and the hard edges look clipped. Both also set the quote in 9 lines with very loose leading, leave dead space at the bottom and pack the two attribution lines too tightly. A is worse because the red attribution sits almost against 'THAT EVER HAS.' with no separating gap. B leaves a clear gap there and uses the space slightly better, so its grouping and hierarchy read more cleanly.
